people.name: Beer
people.line: Site where God provided water for the Israelites.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
translations.bsb: From there they went on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people so that I may give them water.”
translations.kjv: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
translations.asv: And from thence they journeyed to Beer: that is the well whereof Jehovah said unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
